stops.title: Born in Bethlehem
stops.text: Because of a census, Mary and Joseph travel from Nazareth to Bethlehem, where Jesus is born and shepherds hear the news.

stops.title: Growing up, then rejected, in Nazareth
stops.text: Mary is told she will bear a son in Nazareth, where Jesus grows up. Years later his townspeople try to throw him off a cliff.

stops.title: Baptized in the Jordan
stops.text: John preaches by the Jordan, and Jesus is baptized while praying; the Spirit descends like a dove.

stops.title: Capernaum
stops.text: Jesus teaches on the Sabbath, frees a man with an unclean spirit, and heals many by evening.

stops.title: A widow's son at Nain
stops.text: Jesus stops a funeral procession and raises a widow's only son.

stops.title: Feeding the five thousand
stops.text: Near Bethsaida, Jesus feeds the crowd with five loaves and two fish.

stops.title: On the road, between Samaria and Galilee
stops.text: Jesus sets his face toward Jerusalem, and later heals ten lepers, one of whom is a Samaritan.

stops.title: Martha and Mary at Bethany
stops.text: Martha serves while Mary sits at Jesus' feet to listen.

stops.title: Zacchaeus at Jericho
stops.text: Jesus heals a blind beggar and stays with the tax collector Zacchaeus.

stops.title: The last days in Jerusalem
stops.text: Jesus enters the city, teaches in the temple, is arrested, crucified, and buried.

stops.title: The road to Emmaus
stops.text: On the day of the resurrection, the risen Jesus walks with two disciples and is known in the breaking of bread.

real.label: Map of the land from Bethlehem in the south to Capernaum in the north, drawn from real coordinates. Numbered stops mark where Luke's story moves.

stops.label: Jordan River
stops.locationNote: Luke doesn't say where on the Jordan this happened; the marker is placed for illustration.

stops.label: Samaria
stops.locationNote: Luke says Jesus passed "between Samaria and Galilee" without naming a place, so the marker is illustrative.

stops.label: Bethany
stops.locationNote: Luke says only "a certain village"; John 11:1 places Martha and Mary at Bethany, so the marker uses that.

stops.label: Emmaus
stops.locationNote: Where Emmaus was is debated; the marker uses one proposed site.

real.regionLegend: Regions: darker shading where more sources agree on their extent
